raw_response:
I will do it much like I did before, because on 12 mu I cannot gamble. I have farmed this land a long time, and around here if wheat and maize want a steady harvest, I must feed them enough and not let the field go hungry. I watch what the good fields near me do. If somebody cuts fertilizer too much and the crop turns weak, I see it right away. Wasting a little fertilizer costs money, but losing grain costs much more, so I will lean a little heavy rather than a little short. With well water in hand, I will irrigate on time. For wheat, I will use improved seed, put more nitrogen on it, give it 3 waters, spray 2 times, and rotary till the land after the maize season. For maize, I will also use hybrid seed like most people here do, feed it a bit less than wheat but still enough, give it 2 waters if rain does not come right, spray 2 times, and rotary till again after wheat. I will keep the full 12 mu in the wheat-maize cycle, because that is how I make my year’s grain.
